description: Source code for WebKitBrowserWindow class implementing a browser window with WebKit integration, handling navigation, authentication, dialogs, and zoom controls.

classes.name: WebKitBrowserWindow
classes.description: A class managing a WebKit-based browser window, handling navigation, dialogs, authentication, zoom, and window events.

methods.name: createPEMString
methods.description: Creates a PEM string from the certificate chain of a protection space.

methods.name: WebKitBrowserWindow::WebKitBrowserWindow
methods.description: Constructor initializing the browser window with configuration and setting up clients.

methods.name: WebKitBrowserWindow::~WebKitBrowserWindow
methods.description: Destructor releasing dialog listeners.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads a URL into the browser window.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current page.

methods.name: navigateForwardOrBackward
methods.description: Navigates forward or backward in history.

methods.name: launchInspector
methods.description: Opens the WebKit inspector.

methods.name: setUserAgent
methods.description: Sets a custom user agent string.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Returns the current user agent string.

methods.name: resetZoom
methods.description: Resets zoom to default.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Zooms in the page.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Zooms out the page.

methods.name: toWebKitBrowserWindow
methods.description: Helper to cast client info to WebKitBrowserWindow reference.

methods.name: didChangeTitle
methods.description: Updates window title when page title changes.

methods.name: didChangeIsLoading
methods.description: Handles loading state changes.

methods.name: didChangeActiveURL
methods.description: Updates active URL display.

methods.name: didReceiveAuthenticationChallenge
methods.description: Handles authentication challenges, including server trust and credential prompts.

methods.name: canTrustServerCertificate
methods.description: Determines if a server certificate can be trusted, possibly prompting user.

methods.name: closeWindow
methods.description: Handles window close requests.

methods.name: runJavaScriptAlert
methods.description: Handles JavaScript alert dialogs.

methods.name: runJavaScriptConfirm
methods.description: Handles JavaScript confirm dialogs.

methods.name: runJavaScriptPrompt
methods.description: Handles JavaScript prompt dialogs.

methods.name: runBeforeUnloadConfirmPanel
methods.description: Handles before unload confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: handleJavaScriptDialog
methods.description: Processes JavaScript dialogs based on user response.

methods.name: getWindowFrame
methods.description: Retrieves window frame dimensions.

methods.name: createPageCallback
methods.description: Creates a new page, called from Playwright agent.

methods.name: createViewCallback
methods.description: Creates a new view and loads about:blank if needed.

methods.name: createNewPage
methods.description: Handles creation of new pages for popups.

methods.name: didNotHandleKeyEvent
methods.description: Forwards unhandled key events to main window.

methods.description: Decides navigation policy, e.g., for link clicks with modifiers.

methods.name: decidePolicyForResponse
methods.description: Decides how to handle responses, e.g., download or display.
